rows.basis: Freeport's Q4 2025 call deck (January 2026) cites an S&P Global study projecting copper demand from about 27.6 Mt in 2024 to about 42.3 Mt in 2040, with AI and data centers one of four drivers. This is physical-end exposure stated in words only. Freeport states no AI share of revenue, and its regional and product lines (cathode, concentrate, rod) are not AI lines.
No statement in the pack links FY2024 revenue to AI or data-center demand. Copper revenue is not an AI line.
No statement in the pack links FY2023 revenue to AI or data-center demand. Copper revenue is not an AI line.
No statement in the pack links FY2022 revenue to AI or data-center demand. Copper revenue is not an AI line.

Capex of 4.494B goes to mines, smelters and refining (Indonesia, Cerro Verde, Morenci, Atlantic Copper and others). No AI capex is stated, and the thesis forbids estimating from segments or PP&E categories.
Capex of 4.808B is mining and processing capex. No AI capex is stated, and the thesis forbids estimating from segments or PP&E categories.
